observations: Cross Save selects one active character set for connected platforms rather than merging every platform account.
Non-selected characters remain dormant and recoverable after deactivation rather than being overwritten.
DLC licenses remain platform-bound, while authentication and time restrictions constrain changes to the active set.
inferences: Cross-platform continuity requires separate identities for characters, accounts, entitlements, platforms, and active presentation.
A visible selection policy is safer than averaging or silently merging conflicting ownership state.
limits: Cross Save is service-backed account selection, not a general local-save migration design.
The guide does not expose transaction internals, storage, or failure recovery implementation.
